title: Design System: FreteAgro — Marketing Surface ("Estrada à Noite")

incumbentSystem.name: Rayna UI v1.0
incumbentSystem.note: The authenticated product keeps ground #0D0D0D, surfaces #161616/#1E1E1E, primary #16b84f and Inter throughout. This sidecar documents a scoped layer only; the two systems share exactly one value, the brand green.

mkt-ground.purpose: Page ground, mark negative space, and the recreated panel's own background. Deliberately below the app's #0D0D0D so the marketing surface reads as outside the product.

mkt-raise.purpose: The only lifted surface: the settlement document card and the phone chassis.

mkt-ink.purpose: The single ink. Full strength for headings and settled values; /85-/70 secondary; /60-/55 body; /50 floor. Low alphas supply all structure: /20-/15 control borders, /12 unlit rail, /10 section rules, /07-/02 tinted fills.

mkt-signal.purpose: Brand green, shared with the app. Used only where the product acts: the lineage rail, the ledger's bullet, the driver's confirm action, the revenue series, the mark's field, and the two horizon washes (7% and 16% alpha). Never a text background, never a heading colour.

mkt-glow.purpose: The brighter sibling, for green that must hold on black: the settled balance, the final lineage node, the highlighted KPI, the live chip, and the focus outline.

display.purpose: Hero headline only — two lines, left-aligned, capped at 17ch below lg.

headline.purpose: Section headings; the closing CTA runs one step larger and centred.

figure.purpose: The settled balance and the four lineage figures. The only numbers allowed the display face.

title.purpose: Row titles, list-step titles, panel headings — Inter.

body-small.purpose: Supporting paragraphs inside lists and cards.

label.purpose: Captions, illustrative-value disclaimers, meta at ink /50-/55.

label-caps.purpose: Ledger column headers and footer column titles. A table header, never a kicker above a heading.

shadows.name: device-drop
shadows.purpose: The only shadow on the surface. Phone chassis in the driver section, where a physical object sits above the page.

glows.name: horizon-hero
glows.purpose: The one warm bloom in the first viewport.

glows.name: horizon-close
glows.purpose: The horizon returning to close the page.

glows.name: hero-panel-veil
glows.value: filter: saturate(0.3) blur(2.5px); mask-image: radial-gradient(105% 85% at 72% 20%, #000 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.62) 26%, transparent 64%)
glows.purpose: The product panel behind the headline: present as light, unreadable as data.

motion.name: rail-draw
motion.purpose: The page's one authored moment: the lineage rail drawing itself once from its origin. Skipped under useReducedMotion.

motion.name: node-pop
motion.value: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), staggered 0.32s per stop from 0.45s
motion.purpose: Lineage nodes appearing along the drawn rail. The figures themselves never animate in.

motion.name: state-colour
motion.purpose: Every hover and link state on the surface.

motion.name: header-settle
motion.purpose: The fixed header acquiring its hairline and blur past 8px of scroll.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Gutter 20px → 32px; the CTA field and button go side by side.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Nav bar restored; comparison ledger becomes two ruled columns.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Lineage rail rotates to horizontal; panel sidebar appears; larger type steps.

breakpoints.name: container
breakpoints.purpose: The single measure, shared by header, sections and footer.

contrastFloor.rule: Marketing text never goes below /50 of the ink.
contrastFloor.evidence: ink #f4f4f2 at 50% over #070707 composites to ~#7d7d7c → 4.89:1 (AA pass). At /45 it composites to ~#717170 → 4.16:1 (AA fail). Verified against the shipped opacity census: the lowest text opacity in components/marketing is /50.

narrative.overview:
The world is asphalt at night with a screen glowing on it. The ground (#070707) is deliberately darker than the app's own background so the marketing surface reads as outside, not inside the product. There is one ink — a warm white (#f4f4f2), headlights rather than paper — and every level of emphasis on the page is that same ink at a different opacity. Colour is not how this page makes hierarchy; density is. Brand green appears only where the product is speaking: the lane line under the settlement, the settled figure, a live status, the mark. It never fills a background, never tints a heading, never decorates.

Composition is ruled rather than boxed. Hairline horizontal rules at 10% ink separate every section; content sits in a single 1280px measure with a 20/32px gutter; figures line up column-wise because anything numeric carries data-figure and gets tabular numerals. Cards exist in exactly two places — the settlement document and the recreated product panels — because those are objects the visitor is meant to read as artifacts, not as containers of copy.

Scope: this world governs the public marketing surface only, everything under the .mkt class. The authenticated product keeps Rayna UI v1.0 (../design-system/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md). The two systems share exactly one value, the brand green.
keyCharacteristics: One ink on near-black; tone made by opacity, never by adding hues.
Green is signal, never surface: the lane line, the settled figure, the live state, the mark.
Bodoni Moda for display and figures only; Inter for every UI atom.
Hairline rules (10% ink) as the primary structural device; no floating cards on gradients.
One authored motion moment on the whole page; figures never animate in.

rules.name: The Single Ink Rule
rules.body: Tone on this surface is opacity of one ink. Adding a hue is a decision that must be argued for; the shipped page argues for exactly one (green, as signal).

rules.name: The Signal-Only Rule
rules.body: Green marks where the product acts or where money settles. If a green element could be recoloured to ink without losing meaning, it should be ink.

rules.name: The /50 Floor Rule
rules.body: Marketing text never goes below /50 of the ink. On the #070707 ground, /50 composites to ~#7d7d7c and lands at 4.89:1; /45 falls to 4.16:1 and fails AA. /50 is the floor, not a style choice.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Money Rule
rules.body: Bodoni carries headings and settled figures. A number in a table, a chip, a KPI row or a form is Inter — the display face is reserved for the number the page exists to produce.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Anything numeric carries data-figure, which applies tabular-nums / tnum inside .mkt. Money, distances, dates and percentages line up column-wise wherever they can be compared.

rules.name: The Lit-Not-Stacked Rule
rules.body: Surfaces do not float. If an element needs separation, it gets a hairline or a tonal step, not a shadow. Glow is atmosphere on the horizon, never a halo around a component.

dos: Do build tone from opacity of the single ink (#f4f4f2), and keep text at or above /50.
Do spend green only on signal: the rail, the settled figure, the live state, the mark, the revenue series.
Do separate with 1px hairlines at ink /10 and let the ground carry the rest.
Do mark every number with data-figure so tabular numerals apply.
Do keep Bodoni to headings and settled figures, and hand every label, control and table cell to Inter.
Do cap measure: 52-56ch for body, 62ch for long answers, 46-50ch inside columns.
Do rebuild product surfaces in markup from mkt tokens and label illustrative figures as illustrative.
Do keep the .mkt class on any portal-rendered content (sheets, popovers) so the world travels with it.
donts: Don't introduce a second hue. There is no red error state, no amber warning, no secondary accent on this surface.
Don't use green as a background for text, a heading colour, or a decorative fill.
Don't add box-shadows. The only shadow in this world is under the phone chassis.
Don't animate figures in, stagger sections on scroll, or add a second authored motion moment; the lineage draw and the accordion are the whole motion budget.
Don't put display type on a UI atom — labels, chips, buttons, table cells and form controls are Inter.
Don't import the app's dashboard components or Rayna UI surfaces into a marketing section, and don't let mkt tokens leak into app/(dashboard) or app/(auth).
Don't show unlabelled money: any illustrative figure carries a caption saying so.
